CustomField.description: The operator name, denormalised. Exists so the fleet query can filter on it without the caller needing any permission on Account: a cross-object formula is evaluated in system context, while traversing Betreiber__r in a WHERE clause requires read access to the whole object. The agent runs as a service user and has no business holding Account access to answer a question about charge points.
CustomField.label: Betreiber (Name)
